tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Canonical Black. The Competition ground (LIVE, Call-Outs, Clashes). Never a fill beside brand-oxblood: the two sit at 1.09:1 and merge.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Canonical Ink. Primary text on white and stone; raised surface inside LIVE.

tokens.name: brand-oxblood
tokens.usage: Canonical Oxblood — means 'something is happening'. Action fills (I'M DOWN, GAME ON takeover, progress). White on it is 19:1. Invisible on brand-black (1.09:1): on dark grounds it must carry a mark-ring.

tokens.name: brand-graphite
tokens.usage: Canonical Graphite. Secondary text on white (9.2:1) and forming (8.4:1). Fails as text on black (2.3:1): decorative only there.

tokens.name: brand-stone
tokens.usage: Canonical Stone. Archive / Passport / AFTER ground; secondary text on black (8.0:1), ink (7.0:1) and oxblood (7.4:1). Never text on white (2.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Canonical White. Everyday ground; text on black, ink and oxblood.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page / object ground. The theme (situation) decides it: white calm, stone-warmed forming, oxblood confirmed, black live, stone after.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Contained objects on surface (only when an object genuinely needs containment), strips, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells, input fields, empty progress grounds.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and display type, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in every theme (≥7:1).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, secondary copy on surface and surface-raised (≥4.5:1 in every theme).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between editorial blocks. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (chips, secondary buttons, inputs) — ≥3:1 on surface in every theme.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The action colour of the current situation: primary CTA fill, filled progress, the leading prediction segment. Oxblood on light grounds; flips to white when the ground is oxblood or black.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (≥19:1).

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Opposite-ground fill: secondary solid buttons, poster slabs, the VS bar.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an inverse fill.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: avatar initials ground, the trailing prediction segment, empty slots. Pairs with on-tint.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text on a tint fill (≥7:1).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled progress segments and meter bars. Filled ones are signal; segments are also separated by a gap, so count reads without colour.

tokens.name: mark-ring
tokens.usage: The 1–2px ring around an oxblood mark (LIVE pill, unread dot) so it survives on black and oxblood grounds.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥7:1 on every surface of its theme.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: One per screen, max. Breakthrough moments: GAME ON, LIVE, CHIMDI WINS. Always uppercase.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Editorial headlines on Home and Challenge heroes; competitor names.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Plan counts, countdown numerals, poster headlines.

styles.name: display-xs
styles.usage: Strip numerals, stamp titles. Smallest display size — below this, use label.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Object titles, sheet headers, profile names.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 11 people near you want to play.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata, place and time lines, comments.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Stats and splits in UI type. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

spacing.note: 4px base. Editorial screens breathe: page gutter space-5, block gap space-10.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, avatar overlap step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, segment gaps in progress.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside strips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Object padding (strips, posts).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Poster padding; gap between headline and meta.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between editorial blocks on a feed.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section breaks inside Challenge Event pages.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Full-takeover breathing room (GAME ON, LIVE).

radius.note: Ojoro is square by default. Round is reserved for people (avatars, the O) and the commit action (pills).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Posters, strips, editorial blocks, cards. The default.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, input fields, progress segments.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, LIVE pill — anything you press to commit.

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Avatars, the O, passport stamps.

shadow.note: Borders and ground changes, not shadows. One shadow exists, for sheets over content.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and modals only.

duration.note: Motion families: Commit, Gather, Breakthrough, Live. Under reduced motion every duration collapses to 0 and state changes become instant cross-fades of 120ms or less.

tokens.name: dur-commit
tokens.usage: Commit: press → compress (scale 0.96) → lock. Pair with ease-commit.

tokens.name: dur-gather
tokens.usage: Gather: an avatar flying into a participant cluster; count ticks up.

tokens.name: dur-breakthrough
tokens.usage: Breakthrough: 7/8 → GAME ON ground takeover.

tokens.name: dur-live
tokens.usage: Live: one pulse cycle of the LIVE dot and live counters.

tokens.name: ease-commit
tokens.usage: Commit presses and state locks.

tokens.name: ease-gather
tokens.usage: Gather — a small overshoot as a person lands in the cluster.

tokens.name: ease-breakthrough
tokens.usage: Ground and headline takeovers.

tokens.name: ease-live
tokens.usage: Looping live pulses.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-commit
tokens.usage: Height of the I'M DOWN / commit button.

tokens.name: size-avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in clusters and strips.

tokens.name: size-avatar-md
tokens.usage: Avatars in posts and rows.

tokens.name: size-avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Competitor avatars on Call-Outs.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: line dividers and control borders.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Focus rings, mark-ring, selected chips.

tokens.name: border-poster
tokens.usage: Rule bars on posters and the VS slash.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (always with a text reason nearby).

tokens.name: opacity-expired
tokens.usage: Expired plans: the object dims, its headline says EXPIRED.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: Black scrim over photography under display type.
